limits: Useful primary personal advantage over base, pooled and donor remains unresolved under both interval methods. Only the primary base writer interval favors personal adaptation at zero, without clearing the useful margin or surviving crossed resampling at zero. Useful primary uniform advantage is excluded under both methods, narrowly under crossed resampling at full precision. Residual donor and pooled useful uncertainty remains under both methods, and residual uniform is worse under both. Raw base and donor useful uncertainty remains under both; raw pooled useful advantage is excluded only under writer resampling. Raw uniform is worse under both. No useful benefit or parity is established. Shared evaluation units, transferred rank, sparse histories and separate cell summaries provide no independent human confirmation or backbone ranking. Other matrix cells remain unfinished; failed and unknown predecessors remain separate.
